definitions.explanation: A new version of a book, document, software, or other work that has been updated or corrected from the original.

examples.japanese: {改訂版|かいていばん}が{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
この{辞書|じしょ}の{改訂版|かいていばん}には{新語|しんご}が{多数|たすう}{追加|ついか}されている。
examples.english: Numerous new words have been added to the revised edition of this dictionary.

examples.japanese: {教科書|きょうかしょ}の{改訂版|かいていばん}では、{最新|さいしん}の{研究|けんきゅう}{成果|せいか}が{反映|はんえい}されている。
examples.english: The revised edition of the textbook reflects the latest research findings.

notes:
USAGE:
{改訂版|かいていばん} combines {改訂|かいてい} (revision) + {版|ばん} (edition). It is used for books, manuals, software, and other published works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改訂版|かいていばん}を{出|だ}す (to release a revised edition)
- {第|だい}{二|に}{改訂版|かいていばん} (second revised edition)
- {改訂版|かいていばん}が{出|で}る (a revised edition comes out)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{新版|しんぱん} (new edition) may involve more substantial changes. {増補版|ぞうほばん} (augmented edition) specifically adds new content. {改訂版|かいていばん} focuses on corrections and updates.
